name: The Hanged Man at the Crossroads
summary: A young Vistana hangs from the gallows where the Old Svalich Road crosses the Ivlis, and a girl at Tser Pool is waiting for her brother to come home.

stages.journal: A young Vistana hangs from the gallows at the Ivlis crossroads, with a board round his neck that says HORSE THIEF. Someone should cut him down before dark.
stages.hint: Cut the hanged man down at the crossroads gallows before dark, and ask at the Tser Pool camp who he was.

stages.journal: Luminita, who tends the horses at the Tser Pool camp, is waiting for her brother Nicu to come home from Vallaki. He rode out to sell a horse and has not come back.
objectives: Look for Nicu on the road
stages.hint: Look for Nicu on the road: the gallows at the River Ivlis crossroads.

stages.journal: We cut the hanged man down at the crossroads and buried him in the soft earth beside the road, where he will not rise.
objectives: Tell his people at Tser Pool
stages.hint: Go back to the Tser Pool camp and tell Luminita, or Stanimir.

stages.journal: The hanged man at the crossroads would not stay dead, and nor would the field of old hanged men behind the gallows. We put them all down again.
objectives: Tell his people at Tser Pool
stages.hint: Go back to the Tser Pool camp and tell Luminita, or Stanimir.

stages.journal: We told Luminita and Stanimir what became of Nicu at the crossroads. The Tser Pool camp will remember who brought him home.
